pages.text: 26.1.2.0$(br)Initial UAT candidate for the Growthcraft Minecraft 26.1.2 port.

$(li)Ported stable 1.21.1.7 gameplay to Minecraft 26.1.2 and NeoForge.$(li)Restored machines, crops, cheese, screens, JEI, Patchouli, and supported compatibility.$(li)Added clean client/server regression coverage.
1.21.1.7$(br)Current stable release for the Growthcraft 1.21.1 line.
$(li)Completed the stable 1.21.1 gameplay and compatibility fixes used as the 26.1 port baseline.$(li)Retained the in-game manual as the primary gameplay reference.
